[BBC Business] I'm a single mum on £41,000 and limit my weekly shop to £40 - it's hard
People earning from £380 a month to £150,000 a year tell the BBC what they want to see in this year's Budget.

[BBC Business] Minimum wage set to rise but 18-20 year-olds will not get bigger increase
Chancellor John Healey will reveal the new pay rates in the Budget, and has also announced measures to help households with the cost of living.

[BBC Business] Donald Trump's biggest economic problem looks strangely familiar
Donald Trump heads into the US midterm elections with an issue similar to his political foe Joe Biden.

[BBC Business] Rise in sales of radios and tinned foods, say retailers, after call to stock up
Figures obtained by BBC Newsnight show large spikes in sales of torches, radios and power banks.

[CNBC] Anthropic's IPO could be 'speculative fiction' or a 'generational moment' — investors are split
Investors are digesting Anthropic's S-1 filing that the Securities and Exchange Commission released on Monday.

[CNBC] Fed expected to hold rates steady, but Warsh may point way to more hikes
Markets overwhelmingly expect no change in benchmark interest rates following September's increase.

[CNBC] Early third-quarter earnings show a 'resilient' U.S. consumer, with signs of strain
Companies from Royal Caribbean to Coca-Cola and UPS say they are seeing steady consumer spending despite high inflation.

[CNBC] Honda warns 50% Canada auto tariffs would be catastrophic for industry
President Donald Trump has threatened to double tariffs on Canadian vehicles and parts from 25% to 50% if a trade deal is not reached between the two countries.

[MarketWatch] The big reason Boeing’s stock is falling so hard after earnings
Boeing will come up short on 737 Max deliveries, casting doubt on its turnaround plans.

[MarketWatch] ‘CryptoDad’ on stablecoins, bitcoin’s role in a portfolio and why he does not directly own any crypto
What former CFTC Chairman Chris Giancarlo tells his own children about buying their first crypto coin.

[MarketWatch] JetBlue has been losing money for years. It just charted a path to profitability.
JetBlue’s stock rises more than 20% as a new profit target helps calm fears about the airline’s viability.

[MarketWatch] When will Anthropic go public? Here’s what to know about the IPO timeline.
By filing IPO paperwork on Monday, Anthropic can conduct its investor roadshow the week of Nov. 9 and would be eligible to go public as soon as the following week.
